svg.title: How Liner caches and pre-fetches album covers
svg.desc: Album: four tracks share one cover, so it is downloaded once and every track change is a cache hit. Playlist: each track has its own cover; while a track plays, Liner reads Volumio's queue and pre-fetches the next two covers into a four-slot PSRAM cache, so the next track change is a cache hit.
svg.text: Covers are ready before the track changes
Liner keeps the last 4 covers in PSRAM and, while a track plays, fetches the next two from Volumio's queue.
every track has its own cover
next two pre-fetched while each track plays
Shuffle: pre-fetch is skipped (Volumio's next track isn't the next queue entry). Going back a track usually hits the cache too.
